newsitem.title: USA: Harris Corp gets S.Korean airport contract.
newsitem.headline: Harris Corp gets S.Korean airport contract.

text.p: Harris Corp said it has been awarded a $42.3 million contract to provide a communications management system for the new Inchon International Airport near Seoul, South Korea.

The contract represents Harris' part of a $90 million dollar project awarded to Harris, AT&T Corp and Samsung Electronics Co Ltd to provide a complete integrated information and communications system for the airport, Harris said.

The Korea Airport Construction Authority awarded the companies a three-year contract to develop a communications network that will handle all of the airport's voice, information, and video needs, Harris said.
Construction at the airport began in 1992 and is expected to be completed by 2001, Harris said.
